title: Conflict between Grab And Move and Strokeplus.net

judgment.rationale: The exact conflict is reported, but independent low-level hooks and their order make a universal code fix uncertain.
evidence: On 0.99.1 Win+right-drag resizing also triggers StrokePlus.net mouse gestures; the reporter expects only the resize.
The comparison cites AltSnap as not exhibiting the same interaction.

Pinned mouse handling consumes an eligible activation button and uses PassWithoutChaining for active movement; low-level hooks still depend on installation order: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The exact conflict is reported, but independent low-level hooks and their order make a universal code fix uncertain.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate StrokePlus gesture coexistence
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The other hook may observe events before Grab and Move consumes them, or classify a partial input sequence; hook ordering and current behavior require verification.
plan: Reproduce with the same Win modifier and StrokePlus gesture enabled, testing both process launch orders.
Observe which hook receives down, movement and up before deciding whether Grab and Move can prevent the gesture within hook-chain constraints.
If a safe behavior is possible, implement and test it; otherwise document a compatible configuration rather than claiming universal suppression.
verification: A supported configuration resizes without triggering the gesture and ordinary right-button gestures still work outside resize.

reproduce.title: Compare StrokePlus gestures during resize
prerequisites: StrokePlus.net installed and a right-button gesture configured
setup: Enable Grab and Move with Win activation and right-button resize.
steps: Start StrokePlus and PowerToys in each launch order.
Hold Win and right-drag to resize a window.
Try the StrokePlus gesture without Win.
reproduce.expected_result: Resize does not invoke the gesture, while the ordinary gesture remains functional.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Configure a harmless right-button StrokePlus gesture and record which launch order is used.
